To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the combination of multiple obfuscation methods can significantly increase the resiliency time to an attack and (2) the resiliency of an obfuscated circuit is highly dependent on the attack strategy and the order in which the obfuscation methods are combined.

(1) MIRAGE is a system-level framework for logic obfuscation that includes a design space exploration tool to select the appropriate combination of obfuscated techniques, a netlist modification API to apply the obfuscated techniques, and a back-end tool to evaluate the attack resiliability and the obfuscaton overheads; and (2) the results of our experiments show that MIRAGE can be used to evaluate the trade-off between attack resiliency and the obfuscator overheads,

the attack resiliencies of the obfuscation techniques vary significantly with the circuit configurations, and that there is no single best obfuscation method that outperforms the rest for all circuit configurations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following three main questions: (i) How can we quantify the security and overhead of obfuscation? (ii) Which obfuscation methods are the most effective in practice and how do they compare?
the following contributions: • We propose an end to end framework that includes design space exploration, netlist manipulation, and back-end evaluation of obfuscated designs.
the following contributions: 1) We present a system level framework that enables the evaluation and comparison of multiple logic obfuscation techniques.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

MIRAGE provides a system level evaluation of obfuscation with uniform metrics, thus enabling the designer to make an informed decision on the appropriate obfuscation method to be used for their circuit, and to quantify the tradeoffs involved in the process.
the proposed framework is able to evaluate the obfuscation techniques in a systematic manner and to select the best obfuscation method for a given circuit.
the obfuscation techniques that have the highest overhead in terms of area, power, or delay are also the techniques that provide the highest security.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the attack resiliencies of the best configurations are in the range of 2.4 to 4.5 days for the 6 different obfuscation methods, with the average area overhead of 3.7%, power overhead of 1.5%, and timing overhead of 1%.

the proposed framework is a system level solution that provides an automated and uniform evaluation of the effectiveness of different logic obfuscation methods and combinations thereof, and that the proposed framework provides a set of guidelines for the selection of an appropriate combination of techniques for a given design.

MIRAGE provides a uniform evaluation framework for logic obfuscation, it can be used as a tool for design space exploration, and it can be used to evaluate the effect of combining different techniques on the same die.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of multiple techniques is not always the best approach.
there is no single best obfuscation technique, but rather that the best combination depends on the circuit and the obfuscator.
a combination of obfuscations is more resilient to attacks than a single obfuscation method.
